name: AwsSam
help: The AWS Serverless Application Model (AWS SAM) is an open-source framework that you can use to build serverless applications on AWS.

tasks.help: Invokes a local AWS Lambda function once and quits after invocation completes.

properties.name: Event
properties.help: The JSON file that contains event data that's passed to the Lambda function when it's invoked. If you don't specify this option, no event is assumed.

properties.name: ParameterOverrides
properties.help: A string that contains AWS CloudFormation parameter overrides encoded as key-value pairs. Uses the same format as the AWS Command Line Interface (AWS CLI). For example: 'ParameterKey=KeyPairName, ParameterValue=MyKey ParameterKey=InstanceType, ParameterValue=t1.micro'.
